research_rationale:
Executive Order 13606 of 2012-04-22 (77 FR 24571, PDF pages 1-4) is held as the Federal Register original (govinfo PDF text layer, grade official original). I read it in full and confirm its identity and its clause inventory of 26 scopes as prepared (a dup2 suffix distinguishes repeated item labels in different subsections). Its authority is IEEPA, the NEA and the other statutes it names, and it rests on the national emergency declared on March 15, 1995 in Executive Order 12957, on which Executive Order 13606 relies as to Iran. Notice of March 2, 2026 (91 FR 10937; FR Doc. 2026-04450) states that the emergency must continue in effect beyond March 15, 2026, so the emergency, and the order that depends on it, were in effect on the cutoff of 2026-10-14 (NEA section 202(d)). Earlier annual continuation notices for the same emergency are also held; the latest one is relied on because it speaks as of its date. The held original has no own-terms end, expiry or sunset.
